column4: single-dialect test (cleat#3647): it asserts that a call cancelled inside a SQL Server procedure that sets SESSION_CONTEXT leaves nothing on the next use of the pooled connection, which exists only on SQL Server, so it skips whole in a job with no SQL Server. Measured 2026-10-31 with only PostgreSQL configured: exactly one skip, at the top of the test.
